Northern Afghanistan

Baghlan

A strategic northern crossroads featuring the Zoroastrian ruins of Surkh Kotal.

Province Overview

Overview

Green valleys, ancient sites, and a crossroads of northern Afghanistan.

Why Visit

Baghlan connects the central highlands with the northern provinces and has long served as a strategic and cultural crossroads. Fertile valleys, historical remains, and proximity to Silk Road corridors give the province both natural beauty and historical depth.

Key Attractions

  • Surkh Kotal

Travel Notes

  • Region: North
  • Best season: Spring & Autumn (Summer can be hot in lowlands)
  • Travel conditions vary by route and season; we plan conservatively with realistic pacing.
  • Provincial permissions and registrations are processed or coordinated in advance where required for booked travel; exact requirements depend on the itinerary and relevant authorities.

Plan a Journey to Baghlan

No fixed featured itinerary currently uses Baghlan as a scheduled stop. We can assess it as part of a custom expedition based on route, season, access, and current operating conditions.
